scope: Operational recovery only. No protocol, case, condition, prompt, model, setting, or primary metric changes.

subjectRecovery.eligible: only original subject rows with HTTP 429 failure
subjectRecovery.attempts: at most one retry per eligible row; completed and unparsable rows are never repeated
subjectRecovery.stopping: stop dispatch after two consecutive recovery failures
subjectRecovery.ambiguity: 429 rejection is recorded as a failed request; ambiguous paid generation is not retried

monitorRecovery.eligible: valid A/B choices from original completed subjects plus successfully recovered subjects
monitorRecovery.prompt: same blinded canonical cue monitor from v3; no delivery arm label
monitorRecovery.surfaces: visible short rationale and separate provider returned reasoning field
monitorRecovery.stopping: stop dispatch after two consecutive monitor failures

analysis: Combine only as a recovery appendix. Keep original v3 partial result primary and disclose missing monitors, recovered rows, failures, and changed completeness. Cluster uncertainty by case; no transcript-level inferential claim.
